parsed.summary: The PR adds async versions of create, get_or_create, and update_or_create methods to related managers, but it seems to have introduced a mistake in the implementation.

issues.description: The async methods are incorrectly calling the sync methods directly instead of using the async versions. This defeats the purpose of adding async methods and could lead to unexpected behavior.
